# v4.1.1 Rust tray helper

## Summary

- Fixed fully-transparent PNG output for 32-bit clipboard DIBs whose 4th byte is reserved padding (all zeros) rather than real alpha: such images are now treated as opaque, matching the heuristic browsers use for clipboard DIBs. Previously the saved PNG decoded with alpha=0 everywhere, so AI tools could see a "blank" image.
- Everything in v4.1: save-before-paste ordering fix (#4), hardened key injection (#2), switchable path style incl. `@` references for Kimi Code CLI / Gemini CLI / Qwen Code (#5), README FAQ.
